content: Ability of the RTE to generate cyclic function The RTE generator shall generate cyclic functions ( Rte_ComDataMainFunction ) accord- ing to the mapping between variable data prototypes (via RteComDataVari- ableDataPrototypeInstanceRef ) (which are mapped to system signal or sys- tem signal group through data mappings chapter 5.2.1 in TPS_SytemTemplate) and OsTask (via RteComDataMainFunctionOsTaskRef ) together with the po- sition in the OsTask (via RteComDataMainFunctionPositionInTask ) (see [SWS_Rte_CONSTR_09082]).
